subject: Governance-centric renewal kickoff: capacity laddering & QBR availability
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lara Chen <lara.chen@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Governance-centric renewal kickoff: capacity laddering & QBR availability

Hi Lara / Tom —

Thanks for the heads up on the renewal window. I wanted to kick off a short, governance-first renewal thread so we can align on capacity needs, term options, and the QBR slot that works best for your execs. High-level items below — goal is to lock calendar + mutual action items this week.

1) Objective: renew the BrightLayer commitment for a stepped capacity ladder (baseline + two seasonal bursts) while tightening governance checkpoints (audit access windows and evidence handoffs).
2) Proposed timeline:
   - Aug 11–15: stakeholder alignment + data handoff (usage, logs, onboarding checklist)
   - Aug 18–22: legal redline + pricing finalization
   - Aug 25: formal QBR readout and sign-off
3) Info we attached: BrightLayer_Usage_Report_June2025.csv (monthly token/embedding counts), Proposed_Capacity_Ladder_2025.xlsx (proposed stepped commits), QBR_Agenda_202508.pdf (draft).
4) Governance asks up front: SOC 2 report (we have last year’s on the portal), preferred SIEM ingest window for audit logs, and whether you need a private VPC deployment for specific teams.

Can you confirm: preferred QBR day/time (see windows below), and whether Tom or another security lead should join the governance portion?

QBR candidate windows (please pick 1):
- Tue Aug 19 — 09:00–10:00 PT / 12:00–13:00 ET
- Wed Aug 20 — 14:00–15:00 PT / 17:00–18:00 ET
- Fri Aug 22 — 08:30–09:30 PT / 11:30–12:30 ET

Next steps on our side: I’ll share a short mutual action plan after we confirm the slot; Marissa will own the QBR agenda and Ben will pull a headroom forecast.

Thanks,

— Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri...@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

Date: Mon, 11 Aug 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Governance-centric renewal kickoff: capacity laddering & QBR availability

Sounds good — I’ll take QBR logistics. Priyom: I can run the agenda and invite ops + CS. Suggested slot: Wed Aug 20 14:00 PT (works best for the Redwood eng leads).

Ben — can you confirm the headroom forecast by EOD Tues (Aug 12)? I’ll draft slides for the governance section (audit evidence, retention windows, KMS details).

Quick ask for BrightLayer: if you have a primary compliance contact (name + email), please add them so we can include the right stakeholders.

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
Attachment: none
From: Lara Chen <lara.chen@brightlayer.com>

Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Governance-centric renewal kickoff: capacity laddering & QBR availability

Thanks Priyom — appreciate the clear plan. Wed Aug 20 14:00 PT is perfect; Tom and I will join.

A few notes from our side:
- Compliance contact: Tom Ellis (tom.ellis@brightlayer.com) — he’s copied.
- Governance evidence: we need to confirm if Redwood can provide a short windowed export of access logs for June–July (CSV or S3 link) and a pointer to the SOC 2 assertion you mentioned. Also want to discuss retention options for audit logs (30/90/365 days).
- Capacity ask: our traffic shows a ~2.4x seasonal spike for our payments pipeline in November; the stepped ladder looks reasonable but can you run a cost delta for an alternate ladder that adds a November burst (baseline + mid-year + Nov peak)?

On Tom’s request I’m forwarding the usage report you attached.

Lara / Tom — thanks for confirming Wed Aug 20 14:00 PT. Quick summary and owners so we’re all aligned before the QBR: 

- QBR: Wed Aug 20, 14:00–15:00 PT — Teams: Sales (me), CS (Marissa), Eng (Ben), BrightLayer execs (Lara/Tom). Dial-in will be on the calendar invite.
- Actions we committed to: 
  1) Ben (Redwood) — run the alternate ladder cost delta with a November burst and share by EOD Mon Aug 18.
  2) Priyom (Redwood) — upload SOC 2 pointer to the shared folder and arrange a 30-day export of access logs (S3 link) for June–July; share link & retention options by Mon Aug 18.
  3) Marissa (Redwood) — QBR slide deck + governance section (draft) by Tue Aug 19.
  4) Tom (BrightLayer) — confirm any regulatory constraints on log retention and whether a private VPC eval is required.

I’m attaching an initial mutual action plan (Attachment: MAP_DL-4827.xlsx). Legal will circulate a clean-term amendment for the stepped ladder once we confirm the numeric commits. If anything here is off, call it out and I’ll update the MAP before the invite goes out.

Thanks — looking forward to the QBR.

— Priyom
